text: Output is structured as a test strategy with Contract, Priority Properties, Test Plan, and Tradeoffs Accepted sections
States the contract explicitly: what the function promises (exactly-once capture per idempotency key) and what it requires of callers
Names specific Beck desiderata being prioritized and why, rather than listing test cases with no property reasoning
Includes a test for the idempotency short-circuit, that a repeated key returns the existing capture without calling the gateway again
Covers the stated failure mode where the gateway times out after succeeding, and addresses whether the code handles it (it does not; the capture row is never written, so a retry re-captures)
Covers both guard branches: wrong order status, and amount exceeding the authorization
Addresses the non-atomic sequence, that insert and mark_captured can fail independently after the gateway call succeeds
Names properties deliberately sacrificed and why, for example accepting slower or less isolated tests to gain confidence on the money path
